headline: Ann Michael Maye helps families facing food insecurity, presents donation to pantry on behalf of MayeDay Family Foundation
summary: Ann Michael Maye, wife of New England Patriots quarterback Drake Maye, volunteered at Family Food Connections on Tuesday, distributing groceries to families facing food insecurity. The visit coincided with a $100,000 donation from the MayeDay Family Foundation to support the food pantry’s mission.

headline: Patriots' Drake Maye: Shoulder fine, all OK with Mike Vrabel
summary: Drake Maye said Wednesday the physical condition of his right shoulder hasn't affected his throwing ability, instead highlighting the need to make better decisions to reverse his early-season struggles in the Patriots' 1-2 start.
